original.statement: Prometheus metric name prefixes were renamed: crossplane_composition_controllers_* to engine_controllers_*, crossplane_composition_watches_* to engine_watches_*, and crossplane_composition_run_function_* to function_run_function_*.

corrected.statement: Crossplane's Prometheus metric names changed: crossplane_composition_controllers_* became engine_controllers_*, crossplane_composition_watches_* became engine_watches_*, and crossplane_composition_run_function_* became function_run_function_*.

decision.reason: [ev-c3df0dece271] lists the Prometheus metric renames together, under one breaking-change heading with one rationale, so treating them as a single protocol-behavior change (prometheus-metric-names, behavior-changed) is supported. The proposed before/after literals are wrong: they are comma-joined strings that the text never states, and they contain stray embedded quote characters. Before/after are optional for behavior-changed, so I dropped them and put the exact renames in the statement.
